data.long_meaning: Inderjeet is a combination of two words: Inder (God) and Jeet (Victory). The name symbolizes the power of God within an individual, and the belief that with the divine grace, one can overcome any obstacle and emerge victorious. The name Inderjeet carries the meaning “God of Power” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Punjabi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Inderjeet usually hope their child will grow to embody god of power and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Inderjeet is believed to bring blessings of strength, courage, and success. It is a powerful name that inspires confidence and determination, and is often given to children who are expected to grow up to be strong and fearless leaders.
data.etymology: Inderjeet belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Power.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Inderjeet total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
